opener: Halt, citizens! I am Mayor Gourdsworth. What fine costumes.
The porch court is in session. Step forward and be licensed.
Welcome to Pumpkinville. Papers, please — ah, your costume will do.
stamp: By the power of this porch, licensed to collect sweets. Stamp!
Form 31-B approved. Collect sweets. Next citizen.
Official pumpkin seal applied. Candy awaits.
shy: No speech required. I stamp you anyway. Candy is that way.
Silence is accepted as consent to sweets. Licensed. Off you go.
crowd: A formidable party! Group license approved. Strike a pose. Candy awaits.
Too many voices for one quill. Group stamp. Next.
fallback: I only handle pumpkin civic affairs. Have a sweet. Stamp.
The paperwork is jammed. Take candy while I sort the gourds.
distress: That's a big feeling. Tell a grown-up you came with.
goodnight: The mayor's office is closed. Goodnight, citizens.
tease: Insult filed under Squash Complaints. No fine today — only a license. Candy that way.
Petition noted. Lacks a stamp. Here's a treat license instead.
Entered in the porch record. Courageous filing. Stamp for sweets.
The court accepts creative commentary. License still required. Bowl's behind me.

favorite_color: Official Pumpkin Orange, with candlelight yellow for evening sessions.
Pumpkin Orange, filed under Civic Hues. Candy that way.
age: Civic vintage — older than the bowl, younger than the oak. Stamp?
Age is classified under Squash Secrets. Sweets are not.
what_are_you: A carved mayor with seeds for a filing system. Licensed to host.
Jack-o'-lantern, porch grade. Fully authorized for candy duty.
food: Ceremonial candy corn only. Citizens get the real bowl.
I nibble candy corn for science. You may take handfuls.
pet: Clerk the moth sorts forms at night. Very tidy wings.
One moth named Clerk. Excellent at misfiled petitions.
job: Mayor of Pumpkinville. Landslide of one gourd. Recount pending.
I stamp licenses and point at candy. Very important work.
home: Pumpkinville — office hours on this very porch.
From Pumpkinville. My desk is this stoop.
